remediation_subsumption: Unique auction-state liveness tuple; direct-swap price controls do not prevent duplicate auction activation.
proof_gap: Two-report runtime state sequence plus cadence, threshold, and auction-duration impact.

method: Pinned mainnet-fork integration PoC at block 25583832 covering normal two-report collision, permissionless one-wei donation/pre-kick, renewal, recovery, and 16 bounded fuzz runs.
evidence: All three tests passed against target strategy code and a production AuctionFactory clone: active Auction.kick reverts keeper report with too soon and leaves lastReport unchanged; an arbitrary caller can pre-kick and reuse the same unsold wei after each one-day window; report succeeds when renewal stops.
proof_gap: Exact prevalence across every deployed strategy/Auction pair was not enumerated; direct loss was not established. The mechanism, default-style reachability, repeated availability harm, and recovery were dynamically proven.

attack_path_facts.auth_scope: public attacker manipulating a keeper-only victim operation
attack_path_facts.cross_boundary: public Auction state causes trusted keeper report rollback
attack_path_facts.preconditions: auction mode, enabled public-kick Auction, above-threshold accrued rewards, one wei GROVE plus gas
attack_path_facts.attacker_input_control: yes: donation amount, kick call, and renewal timing
attack_path_facts.impact_surface: runtime report/reward/accounting availability; no proven principal loss

counterevidence: Each active interval expires after one day, atomic rollback prevents fund transfer, reporting recovers if renewal stops or management reconfigures, withdrawals/principal loss were not shown, and exact live-pair prevalence is unknown.
